description: Keyboard shortcuts help overlay: a modal dialog listing the command registry ([data-command][data-shortcut]) and data-hotkey actions, toggled by ? (remappable or off) or show()/toggle().

attributes.name: hotkey
attributes.description: Key combo that toggles the dialog; "none" disables the character-key shortcut (WCAG 2.1.4). Observed.

attributes.name: data-label-general
attributes.description: Group holding the component's own shortcut

attributes.name: data-label-self
attributes.description: Label of the component's own shortcut

events.name: short-cuts:shortcuts-changed
events.detail: { shortcuts: Record<string, Array<{ label, shortcut }>> | null, source: 'property' }

methods.name: show
methods.description: Open the dialog (rebuilds the list from the current sources)

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Open when closed, close when open

properties.name: shortcuts
properties.type: Record<string, Array<{ label: string, shortcut: string }>> | null
properties.description: Override list keyed by group name; replaces the registry sources (the component's own hotkey is still listed). null restores the registries.

properties.name: hotkey
properties.description: Active combo, or null when hotkey="none"

childAttributes.name: data-shortcut
childAttributes.description: Command-registry source: label from data-command, group from data-command-group

childAttributes.name: data-hotkey
childAttributes.on: any non-kbd element (anywhere in the page)
childAttributes.description: Hotkey-action source: label from data-hotkey-label or text, group from data-hotkey-group (default "Page Actions")
